findings.title: A full browser store silently rolls a draft back on reload
findings.location: B1 frozen source: client/src/hooks/useLessonDraft.js:15; client/src/lib/lessonDrafts.js:30; LessonChat.jsx:183
findings.confidence: high for the observed desktop engines and stated conditions; target frequency unknown
reproduction: Type Earlier retained draft and confirm its sessionStorage record.
Fill only this disposable origin sessionStorage until native QuotaExceededError (or inject only draft writes as the separate mechanism test).
Replace text with the longer Latest response sample; observe no alert or draft-retention warning.
Reload the same tab; the earlier draft returns. Control: ordinary storage retained later draft through route and reload.
findings.expected: If retention fails, clearly say the latest draft is only in memory and keep recovery/copy options available; never silently imply normal retention.
findings.actual: Both engines accepted the new text with no alert or retention-status warning. On reload, Earlier retained draft returned and the newer writing disappeared.
findings.cause: lessonDrafts.write updates memory, returns false for quota/write failure, and useLessonDraft ignores that return. beforeunload only guards loading/pendingSave, not an unretained draft.
findings.impact: A learner can lose unsent revisions on reload while believing ordinary draft recovery still works. This is conditional draft loss, not evidence that acknowledged server saves are lost.
findings.next_action: Run the retained B5 phone checks after provisioning the exact build and safe fixtures; confirm native storage/keyboard/assistive feedback. Local reproduction and recovery already pass. No target verification claimed.

findings.title: Normal server saving and confirmed save have no distinct learner-facing status
findings.confidence: high for the observed desktop engines and stated conditions; target frequency unknown
reproduction: Open /lessons/practice-14 and send Response with a delayed server save.
Pause its POST /v1/sync/lesson-turn/practice-14 after coach generation; keep real GET and SQLite active.
Wait for the local recovery animation to finish and the coach reply to display.
Type a next draft; Send remains disabled without a Saving explanation. Ctrl/Cmd+Enter produces the reply-wait wording.
Release POST; verify reply via API GET and a fresh browser context. No explicit normal server-saved status appears.
findings.expected: Differentiate local recovery, server saving and acknowledged saved state; a disabled Send action should explain the current operation.
findings.actual: Your reply is saved in this tab appears briefly. During a held save POST the coach text is already shown, Send is disabled and no Saving status is shown. On success the normal server message is cleared. The keyboard send shortcut says Wait for the reply to finish, then send even though the visible reply is complete.
findings.cause: runSubmission remains in qa while the engine awaits saveGeneratedTurn. pendingSave becomes meaningful only after engine return, and normal saved persistence.message is deliberately replaced with an empty string. Composer busyNotice starts empty.
findings.impact: The learner cannot tell whether work is still awaiting server persistence or can be safely reopened elsewhere. Persistence itself worked in the fixture; the missing state distinction fails the requested completion condition.
findings.next_action: Run the retained B5 phone checks after provisioning the exact build and safe fixtures; confirm native storage/keyboard/assistive feedback. Local reproduction and recovery already pass. No target verification claimed.
